classification.difficultyReason: Recover an absolute-value rule from each graph using its vertex, branch gradient and opening direction.

content.prompt: Find the rule of the following.

spec.sourceRegion: Lower left column; questions 35–38 grid, upper-left cell.
spec.description: Upward blue V at the unlabelled origin, with outward arrows, a filled point at (1,2), and dashed projections to the labelled axis values 1 and 2. Black axes have positive-direction arrows and x and y titles. No grid or area shading.
spec.mathematics: Vertex (0,0); marked point (1,2); left branch y=-2x and right branch y=2x. Equal coordinate units preserve the source proportions.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph and all original givens are visible. The inferred function rule is not printed on the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The right branch passes through $(0,0)$ and $(1,2)$.
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{2-0}{1-0}\\m&=2\end{align*}$$
The graph opens upwards, so use $f(x)=|2x+b|$. Its vertex is $(0,0)$.
$$\begin{align*}2(0)+b&=0\\b&=0\\f(x)&=|2x|\end{align*}$$

spec.sourceRegion: Lower left column; questions 35–38 grid, upper-right cell.
spec.description: Upward blue V with vertex at the labelled x-value 1 and left branch crossing the y-axis at the labelled height 1. Both branches have outward arrows. Black axes have positive-direction arrows and x and y titles. No dashed guides, separate point markers, grid or shading.
spec.mathematics: Vertex (1,0); y-intercept (0,1); left branch y=1-x and right branch y=x-1. Equal coordinate units preserve the source proportions.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph and given axis labels appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The left branch passes through $(0,1)$ and $(1,0)$.
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{0-1}{1-0}\\m&=-1\\a&=1\end{align*}$$
The graph opens upwards, so use $f(x)=|x+b|$. The vertex occurs at $x=1$.
$$\begin{align*}1+b&=0\\b&=-1\\f(x)&=|x-1|\end{align*}$$

spec.sourceRegion: Lower left column; questions 35–38 grid, lower-left cell.
spec.description: Upward blue V with vertex at the labelled x-value -2 and right branch crossing the y-axis at the labelled height 4. Both branches have outward arrows. Black axes have positive-direction arrows and x and y titles. No dashed guides, separate point markers, grid or shading.
spec.mathematics: Vertex (-2,0); y-intercept (0,4); left branch y=-2x-4 and right branch y=2x+4. Equal coordinate units preserve the source proportions.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph and given axis labels appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The right branch passes through $(-2,0)$ and $(0,4)$.
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{4-0}{0-(-2)}\\m&=2\end{align*}$$
The graph opens upwards, so use $f(x)=|2x+b|$. The vertex occurs at $x=-2$.
$$\begin{align*}2(-2)+b&=0\\b&=4\\f(x)&=|2x+4|\end{align*}$$

spec.mathematics: Vertex (-1,0); y-intercept (0,-2); left branch y=2x+2 and right branch y=-2x-2. Equal coordinate units preserve the source proportions.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph and given axis labels appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The right branch passes through $(-1,0)$ and $(0,-2)$.
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{-2-0}{0-(-1)}\\m&=-2\\a&=2\end{align*}$$
The graph opens downwards, so use $f(x)=-|2x+b|$. The vertex occurs at $x=-1$.
$$\begin{align*}2(-1)+b&=0\\b&=2\\f(x)&=-|2x+2|\end{align*}$$
